description.value: Xing Fu Tang (幸福堂) is a Taiwanese bubble tea chain recognised internationally for its brown sugar boba and fresh milk teas. This Burnaby location on Dawson Street is operated by Luscioussip Teahouse Ltd and offers both indoor and outdoor seating alongside takeaway and delivery service. A touring cyclist can stop for a cold drink, use the on-site washrooms, and pay by cash or card.
